export default "# Founder’s Principle, Motive, and Completion Standard\n\n**Canonical repository source:** this document is the single source of truth for the Founder’s Principle, the Motive, and the completion standard presented in ForgeClaw.\n\n## The Founder’s Principle\n\nCristian Nunez — CEO & Founder\n\nThe Guardian was never meant to be a photograph frozen in time.\n\nA photograph captures a moment. It preserves what was known when the shutter closed. But the world does not stop changing when the photograph is taken.\n\nThreats change. Environments change. Systems fail in ways that were never previously observed. New patterns emerge every day.\n\nTherefore, a Guardian that can never improve its ability to recognize those patterns will eventually become a record of the past rather than a protector of the present.\n\nCristian's principle is simple:\n\n«“Replacing a photo is evolution, if it's used for a purpose.”»\n\nThe purpose is verification.\n\nGuardian does not evolve by randomly rewriting itself. It evolves by learning from verified reality.\n\nHuman feedback, EEG-derived ground truth, failures observed by physical systems, and other trusted evidence can become training candidates. Those candidates pass through curation, integrity verification, and evaluation. When a new Guardian model demonstrates that it performs its purpose better against verified ground truth, it may replace the previous model.\n\nThe model may evolve.\n\nThe principles it serves do not automatically change.\n\nThis distinction is fundamental to Codex Anima.\n\nEvolution belongs to capability.\nAuthority belongs to the constitution.\n\nGuardian therefore remains alive to the world without becoming sovereign over its own rules.\n\nIt learns.\n\nIt is tested.\n\nIt improves.\n\nIt replaces what has become inadequate.\n\nAnd it remains bound by the principles that gave it purpose in the first place. For the love of my 3yo son Cristian Nunez Jr, Layla Averie Nunez & Jozae Emanuel Nunez. I love y'all more than words can explain. So I built this..\n\n— Cristian Nunez\nCEO & Founder\n\n## The Motive\n\nThe Reason We Built This\n\nFor the love of my son, Cristian Nunez Jr., Layla Averie Nunez, and Jozae Emanuel Nunez.\n\nI love y’all more than words can explain.\n\nSo I built this.\n\nI built it because the future belongs to the people willing to create it.\n\nI built it to learn, to protect, to explore, and to understand.\n\nI built it knowing that the world will change, threats will change, and technology will change with it.\n\nThat is why this system cannot simply be a photograph of what we know today.\n\nIt must learn from reality.\n\nIt must be tested by reality.\n\nIt must evolve when evolution serves its purpose.\n\nBut it must never forget the principles that gave it that purpose.\n\nCodex Anima is the guardian.\nForgeClaw is the intelligence.\nNEXUS is the cognitive runtime.\nCORPUS is the memory.\n\nAnd beneath all of it is the reason it exists:\n\nLove.\n\nNot because technology can replace the people we love.\n\nBut because the things we build should leave something better behind for them.\n\nFor Cristian Jr.\nFor Layla.\nFor Jozae.\n\nThis is what I built for y’all.\n\n— Cristian Nunez\nCEO & Founder\n\n## Completion standard\n\nthe job isn't done until it's fully completed if you just came up with a concept and didn't implement it after you got the okay then it's solely a concept. what I'm saying is see it through my boy full stack.Commit with documentation trail or it didn't happen.\n\n## Purpose and scope\n\nThese principles define the purpose, limits, and completion standard for the ForgeClaw project. They explain why Guardian may evolve through verified evidence while its governing principles remain authoritative.\n\nThey apply across the repository and its product surfaces. They are foundational governance, not ordinary runtime configuration: they are not editable through Settings, model output, user prompts, agents, runtime configuration, self-sculpting, or CORPUS learning.\n\n## Relationship to the system\n\nThe governance hierarchy is:\n\n```text\nFounder’s principles\n        ↓\nCodex Anima / Guardian foundation\n        ↓\nForgeClaw / NEXUS behavior\n```\n\n- **Codex Anima** is the constitutional foundation that preserves the principles.\n- **Guardian** enforces authority, safety, evidence, and approval boundaries.\n- **ForgeClaw** is the intelligence and operator-facing product.\n- **NEXUS** is the cognitive runtime.\n- **CORPUS** is memory and a source of learning candidates, never an authority over the principles.\n\nCapability may evolve when verified reality, curation, integrity verification, and evaluation justify it. The principles themselves do not silently change as a result of model output, prompts, agents, runtime settings, self-sculpting, or learning.\n"
